# NeuromorphicEdgeProcessing

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
The use of spiking neural network principles within sensor-memory integrated hardware to perform real-time, event-driven computation at the edge. This is essential for iNEST architectures, as it enables low-power, spike-based processing directly on sensor data, aligning with the need for efficient in-network neuromorphic computation.
